info.name: Mobtaker Group - CMS APIs (Frontend Handover)
info.description:
# Mobtaker Group CMS GET APIs

This collection contains all public `GET` endpoints for the Mobtaker Group client-facing website and web applications.

### Base URLs:
- **Production (Live Render)**: `https://innovation-backend-xv2x.onrender.com`
- **Local Development**: `http://localhost:5000`

### Key Features:
- **No Authentication Required**: All endpoints in this collection are public content APIs.
- **Full Bilingual Support**: All textual fields return both English (`en`) and Arabic (`ar`) localizations.
- **Clean Response Standard**: All responses return HTTP 200 with `{ "success": true, "data": { ... } }`.

### Usage in Frontend (Next.js / React / Vue):
Set your base URL variable in `.env`:
```bash
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://innovation-backend-xv2x.onrender.com
```
And query any endpoint directly: `${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL}/api/cms/home`.

### Overview
Fetches all landing page sections: Hero Banner with Founder card, Trusted Brand logos, About Sectors, Specialized Companies grid, Purpose/Vision/Mission cards, and Call-To-Action Banner.

### Authentication
- **Public endpoint**: No bearer token or authentication header required.

### Response Format
- Standard response envelope: `{ "success": true, "data": { ... } }`
- Bilingual content: Each text field provides both English (`en`) and Arabic (`ar`) translations.

response.name: 200 OK - Successful Response
